70% of NYSE volume in declining stocks on May 16 selloff
Broadcom miss triggered semiconductor cascade: AVGO -19.6%, ARM -19.4%, QCOM -19.3% from June highs

Nasdaq 100 fell 4.7%+ with 20 stocks dropping 10%+ from highs
distribution_days.confidence: medium - estimated from news reports rather than exact OHLCV data

Industrials (XLI) -3.38% - aggressive de-risking from cyclical sectors
Real Estate (XLRE) +4.05% 10-day return - #1 sector
Financials +3.82% 10-day - defensive rotation beneficiary
Health Care (XLV) +0.79%, Consumer Staples (XLP) +0.40% attracting safe-haven flows
Only Tech and Energy positive in multiple sessions while 9 of 11 sectors declined
NextEra Energy (NEE), UnitedHealth (UNH), P&G (PG) seeing strongest institutional inflows

breadth_divergence.label: Market Breadth Divergence
breadth_divergence.signal: WARNING: Significant breadth divergence - index near highs but breadth collapsing
evidence: Only 42% of S&P 500 stocks above 50DMA (lowest since March 2024)
Only 53% of S&P 500 stocks above 200DMA (down from 70%+ peak earlier in year)
Only 45% of S&P 500 stocks above 50DMA per $SPXA50R (May 21 data)
S&P 500 sat 8.5% above its 50DMA while only 47% of constituents traded above theirs - 'widest breadth divergence ever recorded' per BTIG
~42% of S&P 500 stocks down 20%+ from 52-week highs
Advance-Decline line negative divergence for weeks
Proportion of stocks outperforming S&P 500 benchmark hit 3rd-lowest level since 1972 (Ned Davis Research)
breadth_divergence.calculator_logic: 200DMA breadth 53% -> score 55-(53-50)/10*25 = 47.5, but 50DMA < 30 threshold not met, 50DMA=42% adds concern. Index near highs (within -5% threshold was true in early June, now -7%). Adjusted: raw_score=47.5, index slightly off highs now so partial halving may not apply. Given extreme 50DMA divergence (42% with index at highs), adjusted upward to 78.

index_technical.label: Index Technical Condition
index_technical.signal: CAUTION: Mixed technical signals - index pulling back from highs
evidence: S&P 500 about 7% below all-time high (from June 4 peak)
RSI reached 78 on May 15 - historically 5 of 6 instances led to 7%+ drawdowns
Nasdaq 100 broke below key moving averages in June correction
Gravestone doji candle pattern noted on S&P 500 (Schab weekly outlook)
10-week/20-week EMA crossover risk increasing
However: S&P 500 still in broader uptrend, not yet below 200 SMA
VIX at ~18 - moderately elevated but not signaling panic

sentiment.label: Sentiment & Speculation
evidence: CBOE equity put/call 5-day MA = 0.452 (lowest since March 30, 2022 - pre-bear market)
CBOE equity put/call 21-day MA = 0.493 (lowest since December 9, 2021 - market peak)
Call buying more than 2x put demand - extreme complacency
VIX at ~18 (normal range, 0 points)
VIX term structure: contango (+12 points)
VIXEQ (single-stock volatility) near 1-year high while VIX declining - record spread
Bank of America: 70% of bear market signals triggered (17 of 20 valuation indicators above average)
High PE stocks dramatically outperforming low PE stocks - 'excessive speculation' (BofA)
S&P 500 notched 23 record closes in 2026 - extreme optimism
sentiment.calculator_logic: Put/Call 0.452 < 0.60 -> +35pt; VIX ~18 (16-20 range) -> +0pt; VIX term contango -> +12pt; Margin debt unknown -> +0pt. Total = 47. Adjusted upward to 59 given extreme VIXEQ/VIX divergence and BofA signal count.

composite.guidance: High probability of market top. Aggressive profit-taking recommended.

correlation_adjustment.reason: Distribution days (65) and defensive rotation (78) both elevated but neither >= 80 threshold, so no discount applied

similar_periods.notes: Put/call ratio at similar extreme lows (0.452 vs 0.490), narrow breadth with mega-cap concentration, defensive rotation beginning. Followed by 27% S&P 500 decline.
Rapid 2-month rally of 16%+ (one of only 4 post-WWII instances outside recession recovery). Preceded Black Monday crash.
Similar pace of tech outflows ($15B in 14 days), but different catalyst (pandemic vs. valuation/AI fatigue).

key_judgment.answer: NO - 见顶概率为 68.2%，远超 40% 阈值
key_judgment.interpretation: 当前市场处于'高概率见顶'区域（Red Zone），综合见顶概率 68.2% > 40%。六大指标中五个处于警告或严重警告水平，仅情绪指标相对温和。最强烈的见顶信号来自防御板块轮动（78分）和市场广度背离（78分），龙头股恶化（72分）和派发日计数（65分）也处于高位。
